ex.en: This is the best method to solve that problem.
ex.zh: 這是解決那個問題的最佳辦法。

ex.en: Those kinds of methods are out of date.
ex.zh: 這種方法已經過時了。

ex.en: You cannot solve this problem with the usual method.
ex.zh: 這個問題用一般的方法解決不了。

ex.en: The paper explains its methodology in detail.
ex.zh: 這篇論文詳細說明了研究方法。

ex.en: Some scientists questioned the study's methodology.
ex.zh: 有些科學家質疑這項研究的方法。

ex.en: The distance between stars is measured in light years.
ex.zh: 恆星之間的距離是用光年來測量的。

ex.en: We measured the depth of the river.
ex.zh: 我們測量了這條河的深度。

ex.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
ex.zh: 預防措施比實際治療有效得多。

ex.en: Hackers are adept at getting around computer security measures.
ex.zh: 駭客很擅長繞過電腦的安全措施。

ex.en: I have been taking this medication for many years.
ex.zh: 這種藥我已經吃了很多年。

ex.en: I bought these medications for my father.
ex.zh: 這些藥是我幫我爸爸買的。

ex.en: Do you suffer from diseases that require medication?
ex.zh: 你有需要服藥的疾病嗎？

ex.en: The mechanic assembled the engine.
ex.zh: 技工把引擎組裝好了。

ex.en: Sami has just been to the mechanic.
ex.zh: 薩米剛去找過修車師傅。

ex.en: The mechanic said the brakes need to be replaced.
ex.zh: 修車師傅說剎車需要更換。

ex.en: The news of the merger of the two companies broke yesterday.
ex.zh: 兩家公司合併的消息昨天傳出。

ex.en: The office has been topsy-turvy since the merger upset everything.
ex.zh: 合併打亂了一切，辦公室從那之後就一團混亂。

ex.en: The merger will create the largest bank in the country.
ex.zh: 這次合併將會產生國內最大的銀行。

ex.en: The manager sent a memorandum to all staff.
ex.zh: 經理發了一份備忘錄給全體員工。

ex.en: Please read the memorandum before the meeting.
ex.zh: 開會前請先看過這份備忘錄。

ex.en: The two companies signed a memorandum of understanding.
ex.zh: 兩家公司簽署了合作備忘錄。

ex.en: A memorandum of understanding is usually not legally binding.
ex.zh: 合作備忘錄通常不具法律約束力。

ex.en: I got a piece of lead for my mechanical pencil from her.
ex.zh: 我跟她拿了一根自動鉛筆的筆芯。

ex.en: The flight was delayed due to a mechanical problem.
ex.zh: 航班因機械故障而延誤。

ex.en: His answer sounded mechanical.
ex.zh: 他的回答聽起來很機械化。

ex.en: Data entry is a boring, mechanical task.
ex.zh: 資料輸入是一項無聊又機械化的工作。

meantime.zh: in the meantime：在此期間、同時

ex.en: The doctor will see you soon. In the meantime, please fill out this form.
ex.zh: 醫生很快就會看你，這段時間請先填這張表。

ex.en: Your new card will arrive next week; in the meantime, use this one.
ex.zh: 你的新卡下週會寄到，在那之前先用這張。

ex.en: The Mitsubishi Bank merged with the Bank of Tokyo.
ex.zh: 三菱銀行和東京銀行合併了。

ex.en: The two companies merged last year.
ex.zh: 這兩家公司去年合併了。

ex.en: Branching and merging are two basic operations of revision control.
ex.zh: 分支和合併是版本控制的兩個基本操作。

ex.en: Can you merge these two files into one?
ex.zh: 你可以把這兩個檔案合併成一個嗎？

ex.en: Get into the left lane to make room for the guy who's trying to merge.
ex.zh: 移到左邊車道，讓那輛想切進來的車有空間。

ex.en: Be careful when you merge onto the highway.
ex.zh: 開上高速公路併入車道時要小心。

messenger.zh: 送信人、信差；傳遞消息的人

ex.en: The company sent a messenger to deliver the documents.
ex.zh: 公司派了一位專人送文件。

ex.en: Don't blame the messenger for the bad news.
ex.zh: 壞消息不要怪傳話的人。

ex.en: Everyone listened and was very happy, thinking this wedding was both original and meaningful.
ex.zh: 大家聽了都很高興，覺得這場婚禮既新穎又有意義。

ex.en: Volunteering was a meaningful experience for me.
ex.zh: 當志工對我來說是很有意義的經驗。

ex.en: She gave me a meaningful look.
ex.zh: 她意味深長地看了我一眼。

ex.en: He gave her a meaningful smile.
ex.zh: 他意味深長地對她笑了笑。

ex.en: I've memorized the model number of the charger.
ex.zh: 我記住了充電器的型號。

ex.en: Have you got this number memorized?
ex.zh: 這個號碼你背起來了嗎？

ex.en: I need to memorize these words for the test.
ex.zh: 我得為考試背這些單字。

ex.en: Merchants only look at the profits.
ex.zh: 商人只看重利潤。

ex.en: The merchant sold silk and tea.
ex.zh: 那位商人販售絲綢和茶葉。

ex.en: Online merchants must protect customer data.
ex.zh: 線上商家必須保護顧客資料。

ex.en: With all her merits she was not proud.
ex.zh: 儘管她有那麼多優點，卻一點也不驕傲。

ex.en: Each proposal will be judged on its merits.
ex.zh: 每份提案都會依其本身的優劣來評斷。

ex.en: The plan has some merit.
ex.zh: 這個計畫有它的可取之處。

ex.en: The idea merits further discussion.
ex.zh: 這個想法值得進一步討論。

ex.en: His performance merits a promotion.
ex.zh: 他的表現值得升職。

ex.en: This chocolate factory consumes twenty metric tons of raw cocoa per day.
ex.zh: 這座巧克力工廠每天消耗二十公噸的可可原料。

ex.en: Taiwan uses the metric system.
ex.zh: 台灣使用公制。

ex.en: Customer satisfaction is a key metric for us.
ex.zh: 顧客滿意度是我們的重要指標。

ex.en: We track several metrics on our website.
ex.zh: 我們追蹤網站上的幾項指標。

ex.en: The median of 3, 5, and 9 is 5.
ex.zh: 3、5、9 的中位數是 5。

ex.en: Half of the salaries are above the median.
ex.zh: 有一半的薪資高於中位數。

ex.en: The median price of a home here is very high.
ex.zh: 這裡房價的中位數非常高。

ex.en: What is the median age of our customers?
ex.zh: 我們客戶年齡的中位數是多少？

ex.en: "Call up" is a phrase that means to telephone.
ex.zh: 「call up」這個片語的意思是打電話。

ex.en: I couldn't make out what he meant by 'megafeps'.
ex.zh: 我搞不懂他說的「megafeps」是什麼意思。

ex.en: Swimming in the sea doesn't mean owning the sea.
ex.zh: 在海裡游泳不代表擁有大海。

ex.en: Missing the train means being late for work.
ex.zh: 錯過火車就代表上班會遲到。

ex.en: I didn't mean to hurt you.
ex.zh: 我不是故意要傷害你的。

ex.en: I've been meaning to call you.
ex.zh: 我一直想打電話給你。

ex.en: Don't be mean to your sister.
ex.zh: 別對你妹妹那麼刻薄。

ex.en: That was a mean thing to say.
ex.zh: 那樣說太刻薄了。

ex.en: We are to meet him at seven this evening.
ex.zh: 我們今晚七點要跟他見面。

ex.en: Let's meet at the station.
ex.zh: 我們在車站碰面吧。

ex.en: It was in Kyoto that I first met her.
ex.zh: 我第一次見到她是在京都。

ex.en: I met my wife at university.
ex.zh: 我在大學時認識我太太。

meet.zh: 滿足、符合（需求、標準、期限）

ex.en: I don't know anyone who meets that description.
ex.zh: 我不認識符合那種描述的人。

ex.en: We must meet the deadline.
ex.zh: 我們必須趕上截止期限。

ex.en: The product meets all safety standards.
ex.zh: 這項產品符合所有安全標準。

ex.en: Tom is no longer a member of this club.
ex.zh: 湯姆已經不是這個俱樂部的成員了。

ex.en: Each member has to pay 10,000 yen a month.
ex.zh: 每位會員每個月要繳一萬日圓。

ex.en: Four-fifths of all the members were against the plan.
ex.zh: 五分之四的會員反對這項計畫。

ex.en: This is the car Linda mentioned yesterday.
ex.zh: 這就是琳達昨天提到的那輛車。

ex.en: She never mentioned she had a sister.
ex.zh: 她從沒提過她有姊妹。

ex.en: As I mentioned in my email, the meeting is on Friday.
ex.zh: 如我在電子郵件中提到的，會議在星期五。

ex.en: He knows German and French, not to mention English.
ex.zh: 他會德文和法文，更不用說英文了。

ex.en: She speaks German and French, not to mention English.
ex.zh: 她會說德文和法文，更不用說英文了。

ex.en: "Thank you for helping me." "Don't mention it."
ex.zh: 「謝謝你幫我。」「不客氣。」

ex.en: "Thanks for the ride." "Don't mention it."
ex.zh: 「謝謝你載我。」「不客氣。」

ex.en: I believe the medium size will fit you better.
ex.zh: 我想中號會比較適合您。

ex.en: You only need a medium size.
ex.zh: 您只需要中號就夠了。

ex.en: My gloves are size medium.
ex.zh: 我的手套是中號的。

ex.en: I'd like my steak medium, please.
ex.zh: 我的牛排要五分熟，謝謝。

ex.en: Would you like it medium or well-done?
ex.zh: 您要五分熟還是全熟？

ex.en: It’s a communication medium, not a substance or specific activity.
ex.zh: 它是一種溝通媒介，而不是物質或特定的活動。

ex.en: Television is a powerful advertising medium.
ex.zh: 電視是很有影響力的廣告媒介。

ex.en: The older we become, the worse our memory gets.
ex.zh: 我們年紀越大，記憶力就越差。

ex.en: Neither Tom nor Mary has a very good memory.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗的記憶都不好。

ex.en: The picture brought back a lot of memories.
ex.zh: 那張照片勾起了很多回憶。

ex.en: The memories we make with our family are everything.
ex.zh: 和家人一起創造的回憶就是一切。

ex.en: The event is still fresh in our memory.
ex.zh: 那件事在我們的記憶中仍然很鮮明。

ex.en: My phone is running out of memory.
ex.zh: 我的手機記憶體快不夠了。

ex.en: This laptop has 16 GB of memory.
ex.zh: 這台筆電有 16 GB 的記憶體。

ex.en: There is an urgent need for medical supplies.
ex.zh: 目前急需醫療用品。

ex.en: She made a series of medical discoveries.
ex.zh: 她有一連串的醫學發現。

ex.en: You need a medical certificate for sick leave.
ex.zh: 請病假需要診斷證明。

ex.en: Breakfast is the most important meal of the day.
ex.zh: 早餐是一天中最重要的一餐。

ex.en: He lets his workers eat meals in the office.
ex.zh: 他讓員工在辦公室吃飯。

ex.en: We eat a meal three times a day.
ex.zh: 我們一天吃三餐。

ex.en: Let's have a meal together after work.
ex.zh: 下班後一起吃頓飯吧。

ex.en: We had a nice meal at the hotel restaurant.
ex.zh: 我們在飯店餐廳吃了一頓不錯的飯。

ex.en: Mental health is as important as physical health.
ex.zh: 心理健康和身體健康一樣重要。

ex.en: His trouble was chiefly mental.
ex.zh: 他的問題主要是心理上的。

ex.en: The emigrants have endured physical and mental pain.
ex.zh: 移民們承受了身心的痛苦。

mental.zh: 心智的、腦力的；在心裡進行的

ex.en: Doing puzzles is good mental exercise.
ex.zh: 玩益智遊戲是很好的腦力訓練。

ex.en: I made a mental note to call her later.
ex.zh: 我在心裡記下晚點要打給她。

ex.en: Meanwhile, the circumstances have changed drastically.
ex.zh: 在這期間，情況發生了很大的變化。

ex.en: I'll cook dinner. Meanwhile, you can set the table.
ex.zh: 我來煮晚餐，你可以同時擺好餐具。

ex.en: Sales in Asia rose. Meanwhile, sales in Europe fell.
ex.zh: 亞洲的銷售額上升，另一方面，歐洲的銷售額卻下滑了。

ex.en: Prices keep rising; meanwhile, salaries stay the same.
ex.zh: 物價持續上漲，薪水卻原地不動。

ex.en: Don't look down on him merely because he is poor.
ex.zh: 不要只因為他窮就看不起他。

ex.en: He said it merely as a joke.
ex.zh: 他只是開玩笑說說而已。

ex.en: Labor is not merely a necessity but a pleasure.
ex.zh: 勞動不只是必要的，也是一種樂趣。

ex.en: Copper and silver are both metals.
ex.zh: 銅和銀都是金屬。

ex.en: Metals contract when they cool.
ex.zh: 金屬遇冷會收縮。

ex.en: The acid ate into the metal.
ex.zh: 酸腐蝕了金屬。

ex.en: Please put all metal objects in the tray.
ex.zh: 請把所有金屬物品放進托盤。

ex.en: The box has a metal lid.
ex.zh: 這個盒子有金屬蓋子。

ex.en: We need a better mechanism for handling complaints.
ex.zh: 我們需要更好的客訴處理機制。

ex.en: The body has natural defense mechanisms.
ex.zh: 人體有天然的防禦機制。

ex.en: The clock's mechanism is very delicate.
ex.zh: 這個時鐘的機械構造非常精細。

ex.en: The door has a simple locking mechanism.
ex.zh: 這扇門有一個簡單的鎖定裝置。

ex.en: From now on, I will not eat meat anymore.
ex.zh: 從現在起，我不再吃肉了。

ex.en: In my sandwich there is meat, cheese and tomatoes.
ex.zh: 我的三明治裡有肉、起司和番茄。

ex.en: Could you cook this meat a little more?
ex.zh: 這塊肉可以再煮久一點嗎？

ex.en: The town is situated 1,500 meters above sea level.
ex.zh: 這個鎮位於海拔 1,500 公尺。

ex.en: The area of the factory is 1,000 square meters.
ex.zh: 工廠面積是 1,000 平方公尺。

ex.en: The plane flew at an altitude of 3,000 meters.
ex.zh: 飛機在 3,000 公尺的高度飛行。

meter.zh: 計量器、錶（如電錶、計程車跳錶）

ex.en: I need it for the parking meter.
ex.zh: 我要用它來投停車計時器。

ex.en: The taxi driver forgot to turn on the meter.
ex.zh: 計程車司機忘了按跳錶。

ex.en: I applied for membership in the association.
ex.zh: 我申請加入這個協會成為會員。

ex.en: There's no membership fee for joining.
ex.zh: 加入不需要繳會費。

ex.en: Your gym membership expires next month.
ex.zh: 你的健身房會員資格下個月到期。

ex.en: It's a complete mess, and it's getting on my nerves.
ex.zh: 真是一團糟，讓我很心煩。

ex.en: If you make a mess, clean it up.
ex.zh: 如果你弄亂了，就要自己收拾乾淨。

ex.en: Sorry about the mess in my room.
ex.zh: 不好意思，我房間很亂。

ex.en: I realize I messed up.
ex.zh: 我知道我搞砸了。

ex.en: You messed up.
ex.zh: 你搞砸了。

ex.en: Accurate measurement is important in science.
ex.zh: 精確的測量在科學上很重要。

ex.en: The measurement showed a small increase in temperature.
ex.zh: 測量結果顯示溫度略有上升。

ex.en: The tailor took my measurements.
ex.zh: 裁縫師幫我量了尺寸。

ex.en: Please check the measurements of the room.
ex.zh: 請確認房間的尺寸。

ex.en: The mere thought of a snake makes me shiver.
ex.zh: 光是想到蛇就讓我發抖。

ex.en: Our current crisis is no mere economic crisis.
ex.zh: 我們目前的危機絕不只是經濟危機。

ex.en: She is a mere child.
ex.zh: 她只是個孩子。

ex.en: The cell membrane protects the cell.
ex.zh: 細胞膜保護細胞。

ex.en: The waterproof membrane keeps your feet dry.
ex.zh: 這層防水薄膜能讓雙腳保持乾燥。

ex.en: Tom got mercury poisoning from eating canned tuna every day.
ex.zh: 湯姆每天吃鮪魚罐頭，結果汞中毒了。

ex.en: Old thermometers contain mercury.
ex.zh: 舊式溫度計含有水銀。

ex.en: Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
ex.zh: 水星是我們太陽系中最小的行星。

ex.en: That one over there is Mercury.
ex.zh: 那邊那顆是水星。

ex.en: Exercise can speed up your metabolism.
ex.zh: 運動可以加快新陳代謝。

ex.en: Metabolism slows down as we get older.
ex.zh: 隨著年紀增長，新陳代謝會變慢。

ex.en: The poet uses the sea as a metaphor for freedom.
ex.zh: 詩人用大海來比喻自由。

ex.en: The writer's metaphors make the story vivid.
ex.zh: 作者的比喻讓故事更生動。

metal detector.zh: 金屬探測器（機場安檢等）

ex.en: Please walk through the metal detector one at a time.
ex.zh: 請一次一位走過金屬探測器。

ex.en: The metal detector beeped because of my belt.
ex.zh: 金屬探測器因為我的皮帶而嗶嗶作響。

ex.en: The store sells merchandise from local designers.
ex.zh: 這家店販售本地設計師的商品。

ex.en: You can buy official band merchandise at the concert.
ex.zh: 你可以在演唱會上買到樂團官方周邊商品。

ex.en: There was a great variety of dishes on the menu.
ex.zh: 菜單上有各式各樣的菜。

ex.en: They're at the restaurant looking at the menu.
ex.zh: 他們在餐廳裡看菜單。

ex.en: How many different kinds of pizzas are on the menu?
ex.zh: 菜單上有幾種披薩？

ex.en: Click the menu in the top left corner.
ex.zh: 點左上角的選單。

ex.en: Choose "Settings" from the menu.
ex.zh: 從選單中選擇「設定」。

ex.en: I have to take my medicine every six hours.
ex.zh: 我每六小時要吃一次藥。

ex.en: These medicines should be taken three times a day.
ex.zh: 這些藥一天吃三次。

ex.en: There aren't any medicines that can cure this disease.
ex.zh: 沒有藥能治好這種病。

ex.en: Which aspects of Chinese medicine do you specialise in?
ex.zh: 您專攻中醫的哪個領域？

ex.en: She is studying medicine at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學念醫學系。

ex.en: The media stuck a shiv into his reputation.
ex.zh: 媒體重創了他的名聲。

ex.en: Concerning this issue, I feel that the trash media only report biased information.
ex.zh: 在這件事情上，我覺得那些垃圾媒體只報導片面的資訊。

ex.en: The news spread quickly through the media.
ex.zh: 這則消息透過媒體迅速傳開。

ex.en: My mentor helped me a lot in my first year.
ex.zh: 我的導師在我第一年幫了我很多。

ex.en: Every new employee is paired with a mentor.
ex.zh: 每位新進員工都會分配一位指導者。

ex.en: She mentors young designers in her free time.
ex.zh: 她空閒時會指導年輕設計師。

ex.en: Senior engineers are expected to mentor junior staff.
ex.zh: 資深工程師要負責指導資淺同事。

memo.zh: 備忘錄、（公司內部的）通知

ex.en: The manager sent a memo about the new dress code.
ex.zh: 經理發了一份關於新服裝規定的通知。

ex.en: Did you read the memo from HR?
ex.zh: 你看過人資部發的備忘錄了嗎？

ex.en: The mentorship program pairs new hires with senior staff.
ex.zh: 導師制度會安排新進員工與資深同事配對。

ex.en: She gained valuable advice through mentorship.
ex.zh: 她透過導師指導獲得了寶貴建議。

ex.en: HR stepped in to mediate between the two employees.
ex.zh: 人資部介入調解兩位員工之間的糾紛。

ex.en: A neutral country offered to mediate the dispute.
ex.zh: 一個中立國表示願意居中斡旋這場爭端。

ex.en: Are you planning to take part in the meeting?
ex.zh: 你們打算參加會議嗎？

ex.en: He tends to be late for meetings.
ex.zh: 他開會常常遲到。

ex.en: Only a few people came to the meeting yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天只有幾個人來開會。

ex.en: There is little chance of my meeting him again.
ex.zh: 我大概不會再見到他了。

ex.en: Our first meeting was at a friend's wedding.
ex.zh: 我們第一次見面是在朋友的婚禮上。

ex.en: Would you like to leave a message for him?
ex.zh: 你想留個訊息給他嗎？

ex.en: I haven't gotten any messages from him since then.
ex.zh: 從那之後，我就沒再收到他的任何消息。

ex.en: If she should come late, give her this message.
ex.zh: 如果她回來晚了，把這個口信轉告她。
